# Who unrolls a loop over a constant iterable.
#
# A language target does not: it emits the loop, and its own compiler decides
# whether to unroll one whose bounds it can see. Writing the copies out
# ourselves makes the generated source bigger and no faster.
#
# A target with no host language has no such choice -- a static artifact holds
# the iterations themselves -- so it unrolls at any size up to a bound, past
# which it says so rather than writing a page nobody wanted.

# Kotlin: the loop stands, and the loop variable is what the body names.
sngl generate --lang kotlin --platform android --out droid app.sngl
grep 'for \(row in listOf\("a", "b", "c"\)\) \{' droid/MainScreen.kt
grep 'Text\(text = row' droid/MainScreen.kt
! grep 'Text\(text = "a"'

# Go, same program, same answer.
sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out tui app.sngl
grep 'for _, row := range \[\]string\{"a", "b", "c"\}' tui/model.go

# Static html unrolls: three spans in the markup, no loop to run.
sngl generate --lang none --platform html --out web app.sngl
grep '<span>a</span>' web/index.html
grep '<span>c</span>' web/index.html
! grep 'for (' web/index.html

# Past the bound it is a diagnostic, not 200000 spans.
! sngl generate --lang none --platform html --out big big.sngl
stderr 'repeats 200000 times'
stderr 'build for a language that can run the loop'

# The same program is fine on a target that can run the loop.
sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out bigtui big.sngl
grep '__i < __end' bigtui/model.go

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component main {
    vbox {
        for var row = ["a", "b", "c"] {
            text(value=row)
        }
    }
}

-- big.sngl --
import "sngl:seq"
import . "sngl:ui"

component main {
    vbox {
        for seq.count(200000) {
            text(value="x")
        }
    }
}
